_about: Regression fixture for the M9 discovery artefact (docs/DATA_NOTES.md, 'M9 discovery, first pass'). Real question forms of the 5/15/60-minute crypto series that were listed days ahead and so entered the primary S1 cells as multi_day/intraday. Each entry: the question, the window the parser must read from it (minutes, or null), and the duration class when the market opened 3 days before its scheduled end.
